style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Luigi Speranza
briefs.speaker_context: Global Head of Markets 360 and Chief Economist at BNP Paribas
briefs.current_title: 法巴首席经济学家：美联储还要加几次？三次可能不够

subtitles.zh: 利率又要上行了。美联储，不只是今天，我们该预期几次？
subtitles.en: Rates are going up again. Fed, how many should we expect, not just today?

subtitles.zh: 我们的基准判断已经有一段时间了，是三次加息。所以我们预计今天一次，十二月一次，然后一月或三月。
subtitles.en: Our base case has been for a while actually, three rate hikes. So, we expect one today, another one in December, and then January or March.

subtitles.zh: 但让我这样说，如果三次错了，那是因为是四次，而不是两次。
subtitles.en: But let me put in this way, if we are wrong on three, it's because they are four, rather than two.

subtitles.zh: 我认为背景非常强劲。加息的理由非常充分。
subtitles.en: I think the background is really strong. The case for rate hike is really strong.

subtitles.zh: 我们的经济大致在趋势水平运行。劳动力市场在收紧。美国还有潜在的通胀问题。
subtitles.en: We have an economy which is running about trend. We have a liberal market, which is tightening. And we have an underlying inflationary problem in the US.

subtitles.zh: 那通胀问题呢？要让我们加三次、甚至四次。是的。你看，全球环境是有利的。
subtitles.en: How about its inflation problem? For us to go three, possibly four hikes. Yes. So, look, I mean, the global environment is favorable.

subtitles.zh: 首先，我认为这很重要。保护主义、关税。但总体而言，政治碎片化导致了我所说的资源次优配置。
subtitles.en: First of all, I think that's important. Protectionism, you know, tariffs. But in general, political fragmentation is leading to what I say is, you know, subottima location of resources.

subtitles.zh: 然后还有AI热潮。大宗商品价格、芯片价格面临压力，这在数据中有所体现。
subtitles.en: Then you go to the eye boost. So pressure on commodity prices, on chips, and this is showing up in the data.

subtitles.zh: 有一项数据让我印象深刻，就是计算机和设备投资的价格。
subtitles.en: It was impressed by a piece of data, which is price in computers and equipment investment.

subtitles.zh: 它们已经通缩了六十年，现在美国同比上涨11%。
subtitles.en: They've been in deflation for six decades, and now running in the US 11% year earlier.

subtitles.zh: 这反映了商品价格更高，使得潜在通胀相当棘手，实际上很难控制。
subtitles.en: This is symptomatic of higher goods prices, which makes this underlying, quite difficult, isn't range effectively.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我预计三次可能不够。
subtitles.en: So, I would expect three would not make the trick.

subtitles.zh: 这更多是为了防止经济过度反应。他们实际上是在合理时间内引导通胀降至2%。
subtitles.en: And this is more about preventing the economy from overreacting. They're actually leading inflation to two percent within a reasonable timeframe.

subtitles.zh: 好的。让我把美联储的讨论与国债收益率曲线长端结合起来。
subtitles.en: Okay. Let me marry the Fed conversation with the long end of the Treasury curve.

briefs.speaker: Luigi Speranza
briefs.speaker_context: Global Head of Markets 360 and Chief Economist at BNP Paribas
briefs.current_title: 法巴首席经济学家：5%不是天花板，长端利率还有上行空间

subtitles.zh: 显然，我们看到，我不会说脱锚，但长端利率确实大幅上升。
subtitles.en: And obviously, we've seen a, I wouldn't say a de-anchoring, but certainly long end rates have risen quite substantially.

subtitles.zh: 这更多与债务压力有关。看起来经济表现不错。
subtitles.en: That has to do more with the debt burden. It looks like the economy is doing well.

subtitles.zh: 我们该多担心美国能否应对这一债务压力？
subtitles.en: How worried should we be over the US being able to cope with this debt burden?

subtitles.zh: 如果经济，如你所说，实际上，你知道，你不能增长，如果你在增长，债务也无法增长。是的。我认为财政方面的溢价仍然可控。
subtitles.en: If the economy, as you put it, is actually, you know, you cannot grow, you cannot grow your debt anyway if you're growing. Yeah. I think look at this premium on the fiscal side, it's still contained.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这更多是实际增长的故事。这是实际增长，所以我认为。
subtitles.en: I think this is very much more the story of real growth. It's a real growth, so I think.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，从根本上说，这是实际增长的故事。有美联储信誉受质疑的成分，如果美联储加息，声音足够，我们可以有整固。
subtitles.en: I think, fundamentally, it's a real growth story. There is an element of Fed credibility being questioned, which, you know, if the Fed increased rates, it's in soundocus, we can have a consolidation.

subtitles.zh: 但我猜这是真实的故事。现在，关键风险是我们正走向对财政趋势的担忧叙事，不仅在美国，各地都有一些。
subtitles.en: But I guess it's a real story. Now, the key risk is that we are moving towards the narrative of concern over fiscal trends, not just in the US, a bit everywhere.

subtitles.zh: 但我会说，那是一个风险。所以我们目前的观点是，看，我们曾有一个5%的目标。我们达到了目标。
subtitles.en: But that's a risk, I would say. So our view at this point is, look, we had a target of 5%. So we reached the target.

subtitles.zh: 我会在这里保持偏空的倾向。
subtitles.en: I would keep it sort of bearish bias here.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们的策略更倾向于，如果你愿意，实际上，这是在收益率曲线上。
subtitles.en: So our strategy would prefer, if you want to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to effectively, this is on the yield curve.

subtitles.zh: 在收益率曲线上，绝对。所以是，倾向于在反弹时做空，而不是在下跌时买入。
subtitles.en: On the yield curve, absolutely. So it's, it's, it's, it's a preferred short stretch, or it's in rallies, rather than buying in dips.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，这就是故事。所以我认为5%不是天花板。
subtitles.en: I mean, that's under the story. So I think 5% is not the ceiling.

subtitles.zh: 好的。如果有人想说嗨。好的。5%不是天花板，路易吉。这很有趣。因为如果美联储确实如你所说加息，那能否成为长端曲线足够稳定的锚？

subtitles.zh: 那么其他发达市场呢，对吧？

subtitles.en: You also have the ECB that just hiked rates, BOE. How is pricing look to you on those key markets now?

subtitles.zh: 所以日本央行，我认为会加息。信息应该相当鹰派，暗示加息步伐加快。
subtitles.en: So the bank of Japan, I think, will increase rates. And the message should be reasonably oakish here, suggesting an acceleration in the pace of rate hike.

subtitles.zh: 所以每季度一次。直到达到1.75%，我猜那会是日本央行暂停的好时机。
subtitles.en: So one for each quarter. Until we get to 175, I guess that to be a good point for the bank of Japan to take a pose.

subtitles.zh: 但我们预计他们会在今年晚些时候恢复加息，终端利率在2.50%左右。
subtitles.en: But we expect them then to resume rate hike later in the year for a terminal rate of around 250.

subtitles.zh: 欧洲央行也是，实际上关于欧洲央行，我们可能，我认为市场对欧洲央行有点过于悲观。我确实预计十二月还有一次。
subtitles.en: ECB as well, actually on the ECB, we are probably the markets, I think, a bit to some wine about the ECB. I do expect another one in December.

subtitles.zh: 但一旦达到3%区域和中性利率范围，顶部可能是2.50%，那么我认为欧洲央行对进一步加息会更加谨慎。
subtitles.en: But once you reach the 30 territory and the kind of the neutral rate range, the probably the top is 250, then I think the ECB is going to be a bit more cautious about further rate hike.

subtitles.zh: 市场在上升。我们的基准判断是他们会在2.5%停止。
subtitles.en: The markets are rising. Our base case is for them to stop at 25.

subtitles.zh: 如果他们走得更远，我认为他们之后将不得不降息。而这完全没有被定价。

subtitles.zh: 所以从欧洲央行的角度看，我可能会更偏鸽派。

subtitles.zh: 而对日本、对美联储来说，通胀更多是国内产生的变化，这就是为什么可能需要更多行动。

subtitles.zh: 在所有这些加息被定价的情况下，如果他们确实继续在全球范围内加息，明年此时增长在你看来如何？

- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.

Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.

- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.

briefs.speaker_context: Global Head of Markets 360 and Chief Economist at BNP Paribas
briefs.current_title: 法巴首席经济学家：美联储还要加几次？三次可能不够

subtitles.zh: 利率又要上行了。美联储，不只是今天，我们该预期几次？
subtitles.en: Rates are going up again. Fed, how many should we expect, not just today?

subtitles.zh: 我们的基准判断已经有一段时间了，是三次加息。所以我们预计今天一次，十二月一次，然后一月或三月。
subtitles.en: Our base case has been for a while actually, three rate hikes. So, we expect one today, another one in December, and then January or March.

subtitles.zh: 但让我这样说，如果三次错了，那是因为是四次，而不是两次。
subtitles.en: But let me put in this way, if we are wrong on three, it's because they are four, rather than two.

subtitles.zh: 我认为背景非常强劲。加息的理由非常充分。
subtitles.en: I think the background is really strong. The case for rate hike is really strong.

subtitles.zh: 我们的经济大致在趋势水平运行。劳动力市场在收紧。美国还有潜在的通胀问题。
subtitles.en: We have an economy which is running about trend. We have a liberal market, which is tightening. And we have an underlying inflationary problem in the US.

subtitles.zh: 那通胀问题呢？要让我们加三次、甚至四次。是的。你看，全球环境是有利的。
subtitles.en: How about its inflation problem? For us to go three, possibly four hikes. Yes. So, look, I mean, the global environment is favorable.

subtitles.zh: 首先，我认为这很重要。保护主义、关税。但总体而言，政治碎片化导致了我所说的资源次优配置。
subtitles.en: First of all, I think that's important. Protectionism, you know, tariffs. But in general, political fragmentation is leading to what I say is, you know, subottima location of resources.

subtitles.zh: 然后还有AI热潮。大宗商品价格、芯片价格面临压力，这在数据中有所体现。
subtitles.en: Then you go to the eye boost. So pressure on commodity prices, on chips, and this is showing up in the data.

subtitles.zh: 有一项数据让我印象深刻，就是计算机和设备投资的价格。
subtitles.en: It was impressed by a piece of data, which is price in computers and equipment investment.

subtitles.zh: 它们已经通缩了六十年，现在美国同比上涨11%。
subtitles.en: They've been in deflation for six decades, and now running in the US 11% year earlier.

subtitles.zh: 这反映了商品价格更高，使得潜在通胀相当棘手，实际上很难控制。
subtitles.en: This is symptomatic of higher goods prices, which makes this underlying, quite difficult, isn't range effectively.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我预计三次可能不够。
subtitles.en: So, I would expect three would not make the trick.

subtitles.zh: 这更多是为了防止经济过度反应。他们实际上是在合理时间内引导通胀降至2%。
subtitles.en: And this is more about preventing the economy from overreacting. They're actually leading inflation to two percent within a reasonable timeframe.

subtitles.zh: 好的。让我把美联储的讨论与国债收益率曲线长端结合起来。
subtitles.en: Okay. Let me marry the Fed conversation with the long end of the Treasury curve.

briefs.speaker: Luigi Speranza
briefs.speaker_context: Global Head of Markets 360 and Chief Economist at BNP Paribas
briefs.current_title: 法巴首席经济学家：5%不是天花板，长端利率还有上行空间

subtitles.zh: 显然，我们看到，我不会说脱锚，但长端利率确实大幅上升。
subtitles.en: And obviously, we've seen a, I wouldn't say a de-anchoring, but certainly long end rates have risen quite substantially.

subtitles.zh: 这更多与债务压力有关。看起来经济表现不错。
subtitles.en: That has to do more with the debt burden. It looks like the economy is doing well.

subtitles.zh: 我们该多担心美国能否应对这一债务压力？
subtitles.en: How worried should we be over the US being able to cope with this debt burden?

subtitles.zh: 如果经济，如你所说，实际上，你知道，你不能增长，如果你在增长，债务也无法增长。是的。我认为财政方面的溢价仍然可控。
subtitles.en: If the economy, as you put it, is actually, you know, you cannot grow, you cannot grow your debt anyway if you're growing. Yeah. I think look at this premium on the fiscal side, it's still contained.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这更多是实际增长的故事。这是实际增长，所以我认为。
subtitles.en: I think this is very much more the story of real growth. It's a real growth, so I think.

subtitles.zh: 我认为，从根本上说，这是实际增长的故事。有美联储信誉受质疑的成分，如果美联储加息，声音足够，我们可以有整固。
subtitles.en: I think, fundamentally, it's a real growth story. There is an element of Fed credibility being questioned, which, you know, if the Fed increased rates, it's in soundocus, we can have a consolidation.

subtitles.zh: 但我猜这是真实的故事。现在，关键风险是我们正走向对财政趋势的担忧叙事，不仅在美国，各地都有一些。
subtitles.en: But I guess it's a real story. Now, the key risk is that we are moving towards the narrative of concern over fiscal trends, not just in the US, a bit everywhere.

subtitles.zh: 但我会说，那是一个风险。所以我们目前的观点是，看，我们曾有一个5%的目标。我们达到了目标。
subtitles.en: But that's a risk, I would say. So our view at this point is, look, we had a target of 5%. So we reached the target.

subtitles.zh: 我会在这里保持偏空的倾向。
subtitles.en: I would keep it sort of bearish bias here.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们的策略更倾向于，如果你愿意，实际上，这是在收益率曲线上。
subtitles.en: So our strategy would prefer, if you want to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to effectively, this is on the yield curve.

subtitles.zh: 在收益率曲线上，绝对。所以是，倾向于在反弹时做空，而不是在下跌时买入。
subtitles.en: On the yield curve, absolutely. So it's, it's, it's, it's a preferred short stretch, or it's in rallies, rather than buying in dips.

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，这就是故事。所以我认为5%不是天花板。
subtitles.en: I mean, that's under the story. So I think 5% is not the ceiling.

subtitles.zh: 好的。如果有人想说嗨。好的。5%不是天花板，路易吉。这很有趣。因为如果美联储确实如你所说加息，那能否成为长端曲线足够稳定的锚？
subtitles.en: Okay. If one wants to say hi. Okay. 5% is not the ceiling, Luigi. That's interesting. Because if the Fed does actually hike, as you say, could that be a stable enough anchor for the long enough curve?

subtitles.zh: 是的，我认为这可能导致一些整固，绝对。因为这会稍微降低美联储失去信誉的风险。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think it can lead to some consolidation, absolutely. Because it would reduce a bit of the kind of risk of the Fed losing credibility here.

subtitles.zh: 但对我来说，这可能是任何反弹、任何整固中再次做空的机会。
subtitles.en: But to me, it's a probably an opportunity to go short again in any rally, in any consolidation.

subtitles.zh: 因为基本面故事仍然是关于增长、通胀风险、一些财政溢价，我认为目前尚未完全定价。
subtitles.en: Because the fundamental story is still about growth, about inflation risk, about some fiscal premium, which I think is not fully priced in at this stage.

briefs.speaker: Luigi Speranza
briefs.speaker_context: Global Head of Markets 360 and Chief Economist at BNP Paribas
briefs.current_title: 法巴首席经济学家：日本央行与欧洲央行，加息路径大不同

subtitles.zh: 那么其他发达市场呢，对吧？
subtitles.en: And what about, you know, other DM markets, right?

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，日本央行在美联储之后。几乎可以保证他们本周也会加息。
subtitles.en: I mean, the BOJ comes up next after the Fed. That's almost like near guarantee that they're going to hike this week as well.

subtitles.zh: 还有刚刚加息的欧洲央行、英国央行。你现在怎么看这些关键市场的定价？
subtitles.en: You also have the ECB that just hiked rates, BOE. How is pricing look to you on those key markets now?

subtitles.zh: 所以日本央行，我认为会加息。信息应该相当鹰派，暗示加息步伐加快。
subtitles.en: So the bank of Japan, I think, will increase rates. And the message should be reasonably oakish here, suggesting an acceleration in the pace of rate hike.

subtitles.zh: 所以每季度一次。直到达到1.75%，我猜那会是日本央行暂停的好时机。
subtitles.en: So one for each quarter. Until we get to 175, I guess that to be a good point for the bank of Japan to take a pose.

subtitles.zh: 但我们预计他们会在今年晚些时候恢复加息，终端利率在2.50%左右。
subtitles.en: But we expect them then to resume rate hike later in the year for a terminal rate of around 250.

subtitles.zh: 欧洲央行也是，实际上关于欧洲央行，我们可能，我认为市场对欧洲央行有点过于悲观。我确实预计十二月还有一次。
subtitles.en: ECB as well, actually on the ECB, we are probably the markets, I think, a bit to some wine about the ECB. I do expect another one in December.

subtitles.zh: 但一旦达到3%区域和中性利率范围，顶部可能是2.50%，那么我认为欧洲央行对进一步加息会更加谨慎。
subtitles.en: But once you reach the 30 territory and the kind of the neutral rate range, the probably the top is 250, then I think the ECB is going to be a bit more cautious about further rate hike.

subtitles.zh: 市场在上升。我们的基准判断是他们会在2.5%停止。
subtitles.en: The markets are rising. Our base case is for them to stop at 25.

subtitles.zh: 如果他们走得更远，我认为他们之后将不得不降息。而这完全没有被定价。
subtitles.en: If they go further, I would think they will have to cut rates at later stage. And that's not price at all.

subtitles.zh: 所以从欧洲央行的角度看，我可能会更偏鸽派。
subtitles.en: So I'll be probably be more dovish from the ECB perspective.

subtitles.zh: 欧洲央行与日本央行和美联储等其他央行之间存在关键差异。
subtitles.en: There is a key difference here between the ECB and other central banks like Bank of Japan and the Fed.

subtitles.zh: 目前通胀仅仅是能源问题。所以对经济来说是负面的供给冲击。
subtitles.en: Inflation is merely an energy issue at this stage. So it's a negative supply shock for the economy.

subtitles.zh: 而对日本、对美联储来说，通胀更多是国内产生的变化，这就是为什么可能需要更多行动。
subtitles.en: While for Japan, for the Fed, it's much more domestically generated in change that is why it's probably a bit more action.

subtitles.zh: 在所有这些加息被定价的情况下，如果他们确实继续在全球范围内加息，明年此时增长在你看来如何？
subtitles.en: With all these hikes priced, and if they do proceed with raising interest rates, just about across the world, how does growth look to you this time next year?

subtitles.zh: 早上好，Vaughan。你好，David。香港政府会倾听、会行动，而我们的建言工作永无止境。
subtitles.en: Hi, Morning, Vaughan. Hi, David. The Hong Kong government listens, it acts, and our views work is never done.

subtitles.zh: 所以我提出，五年规划应把另类资管行业列为增长引擎，从而建立并释放一个真正有分量的明确信号。

subtitles.zh: 香港应优化本已优越的营商环境，并定期检视影响本行业的监管规则，在负担合理的前提下审视规则。
subtitles.en: Hong Kong improving the already excellent operating environment and to a regular stock take on a regular regulations impacting our industry where the burden approves it's of the rule.

subtitles.zh: 因为香港拥有世界级的监管机构，包括证监会和金管局。有信心的监管者能够简化规则手册，把香港推向更高水平。
subtitles.en: Because Hong Kong has got world-class regulators in a form where they are subc and hkma. A confident regulators will be able to simplify the rulebook and take Hong Kong to the next level.

subtitles.zh: 仅凭你刚才提到的大数字，这确实是个雄心勃勃的计划。过去香港也尝试建设这类科技园区，对吧？
subtitles.en: It's certainly an ambitious plan just given the numbers that you just highlighted there. We've had seen in the past Hong Kong try to build up these sort of tech parks, right?

subtitles.zh: 无论是中环的科学园还是数码港，这些区域本应培育本土独角兽
subtitles.en: Whether it's what we saw here in central with the science park sell side with cyber port. What are sort of the you know these areas you're supposed to be breeding these homegrown unicorns

subtitles.zh: 但现在看来这些区域更多是在建高楼和住宅。什么将决定北部都会区的成败？
subtitles.en: But it seems like these areas are more about building high rises and apartments here right now. What would determine the success of the northern metropolis?

subtitles.zh: 执行风险确实存在。我们要思考的是如何吸引企业入驻香港
subtitles.en: So execution risk is real. What we should think about is how we're able to entice enterprise occupancy in Hong Kong

subtitles.zh: 我们认为招标结果相当令人鼓舞，至少京东作为锚定租户。京东本身将入驻该空间
subtitles.en: So the reason tender results we thought is quite encouraging at least we have JD as an anchor tenant. And JD itself is going to occupy the space

subtitles.zh: 比最初协议早得多。这是信心票。我们认为下一步非常重要的是关注大学城招标的实际进展
subtitles.en: Much earlier than the initial agreement. So that's a vote of confidence. What we think it's very important for the next step is the monitor what actually goes on in the university town tender

subtitles.zh: 结果预计年底公布。所以让我们关注人才流入，关注还有哪些企业可能入驻并立足香港
subtitles.en: And the results of that is expected to be out year-end. So let's focus on talent inflow and let's focus on what other enterprises are likely to occupy and establish presence in Hong Kong
